name: Severian

description.name: Basic Attack: Swift Edge
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to 4 attacks forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
When the 4th attack hits an enemy, it accumulates 20 <Term:1000041></Term>.
The 4th attack can dodge enemy attacks upon the moment of activation. Upon successfully dodging an enemy attack, this Basic Attack's DMG Multiplier and Daze Multiplier are increased to those of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind</color>, and an additional 15 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> is accumulated.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th attack.
When Severian uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Spontaneity</color> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> combo, it does not interrupt the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> combo sequence.

description.name: Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind
description.desc:
Automatically activates when Severian is attacked at the moment he launches the first three attacks of his Basic Attack, or when he has <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> and is hit by a non-Control Skill enemy attack while not invulnerable:
Dash forward, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> to enemies in an area ahead.
Upon activating this skill, accumulates 15 <Term:1000041></Term>. Upon hitting an enemy, an additional 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> is accumulated.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> while activating this skill to Quick Launch <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>. When the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color> is unleashed, it accumulates 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt
description.desc:
With enough <Term:1000041></Term>, consume 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> and hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Dodge backward and charge up, then continuously dart around the field while unleashing slashes, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> to enemies in an area in front.
The backward dodge can dodge enemy attacks. Successfully dodging an enemy attack triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> and accumulates 15 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

param.name: 4th Attack Successful Perfect Dodge DMG Multiplier
4th Attack Successful Perfect Dodge Daze Multiplier

description.name: Dodge: Windshift
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Windshift</color> triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, it accumulates 15 <Term:1000041></Term>. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dash Attack: Sheer Assault
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Attack forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Fatal End
description.desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Windshift</color> triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch a quick slash forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
If switched off-field immediately after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Windshift</color>, this skill activates automatically.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dodge: Spontaneity
description.desc:
After dodging backward, hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Provoke the enemy.

description.name: Special Attack: Gale Rend
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Unleash slashes and stabs forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Swiftwind Rupture
description.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleash a combination of slashes, claw strikes, and cannon fire forward, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> and gaining 1 stack of <Term:1000042></Term>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to continuously consume Energy before the cannon attack, and repeatedly launch wind blades that deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> to enemies.
When reaching the maximum Energy consumed, gain an additional stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Chain Attack: Coldblade Reap
description.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Perform a series of attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
After using this skill, accumulate 35 <Term:1000041></Term>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Ultimate: Annihilating Windstorm
description.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleash multiple rapid slashes in succession, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Accumulate 100 <Term:1000041></Term> after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Quick Assist: Field Orders
description.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Dash forward quickly, unleashing claw strikes and slashes at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist: Provocation Prohibited
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Fight Force with Force
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash slashes, claw strikes, and cannon fire against enemies in sequence, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Entry Skill: Clear Out
description.desc:
When Severian has <Term:1000043></Term> and is in combat, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to switch him into battle and activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash against enemies ahead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Activating this skill is considered activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

name: Core Passive: Endless Breeze
Additional Ability: Optimal Setup
desc:
Severian's CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>, and his DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>. If there is another Wind character in the squad, his DMG increases by an additional <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
When Severian uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Swift Edge</color> just before being hit by an enemy attack, he can dodge the attack. If he dodges it with any of the first three hits of his Basic Attack, he automatically launches <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind</color>. If he dodges it with the 4th hit, that Basic Attack's DMG Multiplier and Daze Multiplier are increased to match <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind</color>.
When Severian enters the battlefield, he gains 2 stacks of <Term:1000042></Term>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
When Severian has <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> and is not invulnerable, if he is hit by a non-Control Skill enemy attack that he fails to actively dodge or parry, he consumes 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> to automatically dodge the attack and launch <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind</color>.
Successfully dodging an enemy attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Swift Edge</color>, automatically dodging an enemy attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color>, or directly dodging an enemy attack all count as a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> can stack up to 2 times. If Severian gains <color=#FFFFFF>Shadowflash</color> while already possessing maximum stacks, he gains 1 stack of <Term:1000043></Term> instead, and the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Swift Edge</color> is enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind</color>.
Each time Severian performs a Perfect Dodge, he gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Windborne</color>. While Severian has <color=#FFFFFF>Windborne</color> and is in combat, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to switch him from off-field to on-field and launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill</color>.
Severian gains <Term:1000041></Term> by hitting enemies with certain skills or triggering a Perfect Dodge. <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> is capped at 150 points.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> reaches 100 points, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> and launch <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character, or shares the same faction:
For every 1% CRIT Rate Severian has, his ATK increases by 8.5, up to 100% CRIT Rate.

1.name: Double Espresso
1.desc:
When Severian uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the accumulated <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> increases to 50.
When Severian switches in through <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill: Clear Out</color>, the skill is replaced with a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>. The entry type is not changed, and it is treated as a non-heavy attack. This effect can trigger once every 60s.
Each time Severian uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>, he gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Windborne</color>.
When Severian's attacks hit a target, they ignore 15% of the target's Wind RES.

2.name: Reins of Reason
2.desc:
When Severian enters the battlefield, he recovers 150 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color>. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When Severian triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> or uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>, his PEN Ratio increases by 20% for 25s.

4.name: Between Light and Shadow
4.desc:
When Severian enters combat or switches on-field, his ATK increases by 10% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Severian uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>, his Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10% for 15s.

6.name: Beneath a Little Star
6.desc:
Severian's max <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> increases to 180, and the <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color> gained when entering the battlefield increases to 180.
The additional DMG Multiplier of the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color> is increased by a fixed 350%.
Upon using the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt</color>, Severian gains <color=#FFFFFF>Windrise</color>: Accumulates 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Flow</color>/s for 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

Automatically dodges enemy attacks and counters
